status: Nothing interaction source verified; daily-browser acceptance remains separate; values are implementation defaults, not official brand specifications
source: 2026-09-26 user-approved full extension and site interaction redesign; supersedes warm copper materials

popup.font: Seven final mixed families; Geist Code or System mono; System or Emoji3D

appearance.dots: identity, purposeful icons and state; no wallpaper texture
appearance.primary: inverse solid or one sparse red action
appearance.secondary: quiet unboxed text or icon, visible hover and keyboard focus
appearance.selected: solid contrasting surface plus semantic selected state
appearance.disabled: readable muted state, no disappearing labels

motion.reducedMotion: immediate state change; no translation, scale or looping
motion.interruption: continue from presented state; never delay actions or persistence
motion.scope: local content and owned controls; browser-owned popup window and native context menu timing remain native

opening.measure: open-to-first-paint and open-to-enabled-local-controls on named device; cold/warm/offline, record CPU/network

safari: eight generated and signed identities; installed UI evidence remains separate

typography.catalog: seven final families, one shared platform Emoji3D fallback
typography.siteFont: inherit / any final family / website original

weight.variable: Geist Code and capable website fonts; static faces retain source weights

typography.verification: source gate, packaged binary hashes, installed version and physical rendered/persisted behavior remain separate
